summary: Comprehensive frontend testing completed for Devotio Rewards Scanner App. All key features verified: Spanish language throughout, customer name VISIBLE (not masked), email/phone MASKED, mandatory comment field with asterisk, read-only purchase amount in confirmation modal, Costa Rican Colón (₡) currency, pink/purple gradient branding, Devotio logo displayed correctly.
passed_tests: Login page displays Devotio logo and Spanish text (Iniciar Sesión, Correo Electrónico, Contraseña)
Scanner page shows Spanish text (Escanear, Buscar clientes, Escáner de códigos de barras y QR)
Manual card entry works for all demo cards (DEMO-001 through DEMO-007)
Result page shows customer name VISIBLE (Maria González, Carlos Rodriguez, Ana Martinez, Sofia Lopez, Miguel Santos)
Confirmation modal shows mandatory comment field with asterisk (*)
Confirmation modal validates comment is required (El comentario es obligatorio)
Confirmation modal shows purchase amount from initial entry (read-only, not editable)
Currency displayed as Costa Rican Colón (₡5 000)
Settings page in Spanish (Configuración, Vibración, Sonido, Mostrar resultado, Copiar al portapapeles)
Support page in Spanish (Soporte, Documentación, Preguntas Frecuentes)
Sidebar menu in Spanish (Menú, Inicio, Configuración, Soporte, Cerrar Sesión)
Pink/purple gradient branding colors applied throughout
Devotio logo displayed in header and login page
All card types display correctly (stamp_card, cashback_card, discount_card, gift_card, coupon, multipass)
seed_data_creation: Using existing demo cards DEMO-001 through DEMO-007
